NBA All-Star 2027 in Phoenix: the weekend, the arena and getting there

An All-Star ride from Scottsdale Sprinters starts with the NBA’s own announcement, a realistic rider count and one transportation lead. VIP and courtside guests lead with the Maybach Jet Sprinter; friends and fan crews ride the Executive Black Sprinter or a Limo Party Sprinter; corporate hosts take the mini coach, the mini bus or the full-size coach. This guide uses only published NBA and arena facts, leaves the unannounced schedule for closer to the date, and turns each day of the weekend into a written pickup, arrival and return plan. Scottsdale Sprinters is not affiliated with the NBA, the Phoenix Suns or Mortgage Matchup Center.

Last updated: September 24, 2026

When is NBA All-Star weekend 2027, and where is it?

NBA All-Star 2027 is in Phoenix from Friday, February 19 to Sunday, February 21, 2027. The 76th NBA All-Star Game is on Sunday, February 21, at Mortgage Matchup Center, home of the Phoenix Suns, at 201 East Jefferson Street in downtown Phoenix. Tip-off times are announced by the NBA closer to the date. The NBA announced Phoenix as the host on March 7, 2024. Its release names the arena Footprint Center; it is the same building, renamed Mortgage Matchup Center by the Suns and the Mercury on October 2, 2025. Use that name when you book and when you give the address: 201 East Jefferson Street, Phoenix, AZ 85004, on the southeast corner of 1st Street and Jefferson. As announced in March 2024, the on-court events start on Friday, February 19, with a showcase of top rookies and second-year players, then a Saturday night of contests on February 20, and the All-Star Game itself on Sunday, February 21. The NBA also plans a practice, a celebrity game and a fan fest at venues around Phoenix. Where and when each of those takes place is announced by the NBA closer to the date. So this page prints no tip-off time, no Saturday venue and no fan-fest address. When the NBA publishes the 2027 schedule, the reservations team plans each pickup from it, not from a previous year’s weekend. Until then a quote can still hold the days, the hotel, the group size and the vehicle.

Where do you park for the NBA All-Star Game, and where is drop-off?

For a game or event, Mortgage Matchup Center publishes 3rd Street, just south of Jefferson, at the green curb as its drop-off and pickup, and garages within walking distance bought ahead through ParkWhiz. The 2027 All-Star parking and traffic plan is announced closer to the date. With a chauffeured ride nobody drives or parks. The arena’s own event-night plan, which is the one published now: several garages and lots within walking distance, with guests encouraged to buy parking in advance through ParkWhiz. Event parking is generally available from about 30 minutes before doors open, parking does not include in-and-out privileges, and availability, pricing and access may vary by event. The arena lists more than 700 on-site spaces and publishes no price. Valet is available only for select ticketed guests and membership-based areas; it is not open to the general public. Vehicles cannot be parked or left unattended in the drop-off zones, so the curb on 3rd Street is a place to unload, not to wait. Drop-off for will call and the ticket office is on 1st Street, just north of Madison. An All-Star weekend can bring its own street closures and a security perimeter around the arena. None is published for 2027, so this page does not guess one. Your chauffeur unloads at the arena’s published curb or where event and police staff direct, and the reservations team passes on any 2027 instruction the NBA or the city publishes.

Where do rideshares drop off and pick up at Mortgage Matchup Center?

The arena lists 4 Lyft drop-off points: 1st Street at Jefferson by the arena plaza, South 2nd Street, South 3rd Street at the Phoenix Convention Center, and East Jefferson Street. Rideshare pickup is at South 3rd Street and East Jefferson Street, by the Phoenix Convention Center. A booked chauffeur uses the 3rd Street curb or where staff direct. After a game every rideshare in downtown Phoenix is heading for the same corner. A chauffeured vehicle is booked before the weekend, so the group is not waiting on surge pricing or a car that cannot reach the pin. Name one meeting point before going in, and one person who counts heads before anyone walks to the curb. Light rail is the other published option: the arena says light rail fare is included in a ticket to any game or event there, bus fare excepted. Stations and bus stops are on accessible routes. That helps a guest who is staying downtown; a group coming from a Scottsdale resort usually wants the door-to-door ride.

Which vehicle fits an All-Star VIP, fan or corporate group?

VIP and courtside guests lead with the Maybach Jet Sprinter, which seats 9, then the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter and the Luxury SUV (Suburban); friends and fan crews ride the Executive Black Sprinter or a Limo Party Sprinter; corporate hosts take the mini coach, the white Sprinter, the mini bus or the full-size coach. The table uses current published names, seated capacities, hourly rates and minimums, in the page’s three groups. VIP and courtside guests: the Maybach Jet Sprinter, our pick for All-Star weekend, seats 9 at $295/hr in a private jet cabin with Maybach massage recliners, a wet bar and a full partition, then the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter and the Luxury SUV (Suburban). A VIP party larger than the Maybach Jet Sprinter rides in two vehicles, one booking each for the same times: the Maybach Jet Sprinter with the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter seats 17, and with the Luxury SUV (Suburban) it seats 15. Friends and fan crews: the Executive Black Sprinter and the two Limo Party Sprinters. Corporate hospitality: the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax), the Executive White Sprinter, the Mini Bus and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach, the largest in the table at 56 seats. Count riders for each direction. The ride to the game and the ride home are often different lists, and a guest who leaves with another host should come off the return manifest before seats are assigned. Arrive without bags where you can: the arena encourages it, allows small clutches and crossbody bags, and does not allow standard backpacks inside.

How does pickup after the All-Star Game work downtown?

Plan 2 steps: the group gathers at one meeting point the chauffeur and the transportation lead agreed before tip-off, then walks to the vehicle together once the lead confirms where it is. No vehicle may wait in the arena’s drop-off zone, so the chauffeur clears the curb after drop-off and comes back for the group. What if the game runs late? Your chauffeur waits; extra time is billed hourly at the vehicle’s rate — just call or text us to extend. Book by the hour and the vehicle is yours for the whole block: the dinner before, the arena, the after-party and the ride back to the hotel. A ride there and a ride back is the other shape; it suits a group that knows it will leave with the crowd. Either way the chauffeur follows event and police staff on the day. For more than one return wave, label each vehicle, its lead and its hotel. A VIP group heading to a resort and a client group heading to another hotel should not rely on spotting a driver in a crowd. The final sweep checks the manifest before the vehicle rolls.

Can one booking cover the whole All-Star weekend?

Each day is its own booking by the hour, and one request can hold all 3 days, February 19 to 21: the reservations team quotes each day’s vehicle and hours together. Friday and Saturday times are announced by the NBA closer to the date, so those blocks stay flexible until the schedule is out. A weekend plan often starts at the airport: a VIP guest landing at Phoenix Sky Harbor can be met there and driven to the hotel, and the rest of the weekend fills in around the game, with dinners, a hotel party and the fan events once the NBA names their venues. Write one line per day: the pickup address and ready time, the destination, the return rule, and the name of the person who owns the headcount. Leave the unannounced lines open rather than copying last year’s weekend, and let the reservations team fill them in when the NBA publishes the 2027 schedule.

How far ahead should All-Star weekend transportation be booked?

No fixed lead time applies: availability for February 19 to 21 varies by vehicle, and the 9-seat Maybach Jet Sprinter is a single unit. Request a quote with the days, the hotel, the rider count and the group, and the reservations team confirms what is open and holds it in writing. The first request needs the days, the lodging or pickup area, the likely passenger count and which group is riding: VIP and courtside guests, a fan crew or a corporate hospitality list. A group does not need every name to begin, but it should separate committed riders from possible ones. In the final 48 hours, verify addresses, contact numbers and the newest NBA and arena directions, and send one summary to riders. If staff change the approach on the day, the chauffeur follows them and the transportation lead relays the update. Reach the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

How is All-Star transportation priced per person?

For 9 guests sharing the Maybach Jet Sprinter across 5 billed hours, its published $295-per-hour rate works out to about $164 per person before tax for the whole shared ride; the price changes with the vehicle, the hours, the add-ons and the confirmed plan. The same arithmetic for a fan crew of 14 in the Executive Black Sprinter at $145/hr for 5 hours is about $52 each. It is hourly rate times billed hours, divided by riders, not a flat game-night fare. If fewer people ride, divide across fewer. Every vehicle has a minimum number of hours, shown in the table. The ready-made packages on this page add extras from the published add-on list, and each one is priced by the same engine as the vehicle, so the number on the tile is the number at checkout, before tax.

Frequently asked questions

When is NBA All-Star weekend 2027?

Friday, February 19 to Sunday, February 21, 2027, in Phoenix. The NBA All-Star Game is on Sunday, February 21. The full weekend schedule and tip-off times are announced by the NBA closer to the date.

Where is the 2027 NBA All-Star Game?

At Mortgage Matchup Center, home of the Phoenix Suns, 201 East Jefferson Street, Phoenix, AZ 85004. The NBA’s 2024 announcement calls it Footprint Center; the arena was renamed in October 2025.

What time does NBA All-Star 2027 start?

Not yet announced. The NBA publishes tip-off times for the Friday, Saturday and Sunday events closer to the date. Book the day now and the reservations team sets the pickup time once the schedule is out.

Where do you park for the All-Star Game at Mortgage Matchup Center?

On a normal event night, in the garages and lots within walking distance, bought ahead through ParkWhiz, with no in-and-out. Valet is not open to the general public. The All-Star weekend parking plan is announced closer to the date.

Where is drop-off at Mortgage Matchup Center?

On 3rd Street, just south of Jefferson, at the green curb, for games and events. Vehicles cannot wait there, so a chauffeur unloads, clears the curb and comes back for the group at the time you set.

Is Mortgage Matchup Center the same as Footprint Center?

Yes. The Suns and the Mercury renamed Footprint Center as Mortgage Matchup Center on October 2, 2025. It is the same arena at 201 East Jefferson Street in downtown Phoenix.

What if the game runs late?

Your chauffeur waits; extra time is billed hourly at the vehicle’s rate — just call or text us to extend.

Does a ride booking include All-Star tickets?

No. Buy tickets only through the NBA’s official channels; a ride booking does not include tickets, credentials or hospitality. Scottsdale Sprinters is not affiliated with the NBA, the Phoenix Suns or Mortgage Matchup Center.
